verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is that brand kits can be accessed and managed through the MCP server (canva-docs-20), and that Brand Templates help teams produce on-brand designs (canva-docs-15). That loosely suggests centrally managed brand styles, but nothing describes token or variable management. missing for 10: explicit color/spacing/typography tokens or variables, modes/themes (e.g., light/dark) applied across designs, documentation of how brand kit values propagate to designs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
